usergroup_ids.desc: One to 100 user groups for named\_entities. Duplicates count toward the input limit and are stored once. Omit for other permission types.

desc: Sets who a Slackbot skill is automatically turned on for.

errors.audience_too_large: Validating this audience requires more than 1,000 member checks across the requested groups. Overlapping members count once per group. Select a smaller audience, or share the canvas org-wide if that access is intended, before retrying.
errors.feature_not_enabled: The Skills API is not enabled for this organization or workspace.
errors.method_not_supported_for_skill_type: Only canvas skills can be deployed.
errors.named_entities_cannot_be_empty: Provide at least one user group for named\_entities.
errors.restricted_action: The caller must be an org admin or owner with permission to manage skills.
errors.skill_not_found: The skill is missing, deleted, no longer a skill, or outside this organization or workspace.
errors.skill_not_visible_to_audience: Share the skill first. usergroup\_ids lists the groups that cannot view it.
errors.usergroup_not_found: invalid\_usergroup\_ids lists missing, deleted or foreign user groups.
